segments.comment: options.c nmcpy() keeps PL_NSIZ - 1 (31) bytes of the name option, and role.c plnamesuffix() then splits the role suffix at each '-'. The name before the suffix is 19 UTF-8 bytes in 15 characters, so the cut falls exactly after "-Val-Hum-Fem" and drops "-Neu": the role, race and gender come from the suffix, and the game asks for the alignment. The answer n opens the alignment menu and l picks lawful. Seed, clock and name were chosen before any recording.
